sectionDescriptions.general: How Riff starts, where it keeps things, and how to move or reset it.
sectionDescriptions.appearance: Theme, spacing, scale and the window frame.

startupRoute.label: On launch, open
startupRoute.description: Which page Riff shows when it starts.

startupOptions.last-used: The page I was last on

restoreWindow.label: Restore window size and position
restoreWindow.description: Position is a request your window manager may decline. Under Wayland, most compositors place windows themselves.

dataLocations.label: Data locations
dataLocations.description: Everything Riff stores lives in these folders and nowhere else.

importExport.label: Move your settings
importExport.description: Copy your settings to another machine, or bring them back.

importConfirm.title: Replace your settings?
importConfirm.body: The file you pick replaces your current General and Appearance settings. This cannot be undone. Your onboarding choice is kept.

reset.label: Reset all settings
reset.description: Restores General and Appearance to their defaults, and returns any pane in its own window to the grid. Your onboarding choice is kept.
reset.confirmBody: General and Appearance return to their defaults, and any pane in its own window docks back. This cannot be undone.

rerunOnboarding.label: Run first-time setup again
rerunOnboarding.description: Shows the welcome, theme and privacy steps once more.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Riff does not follow your desktop; you chose this during setup and can change it here.

density.label: Density
density.description: Adjusts spacing without changing text size.

uiScale.label: Interface scale
uiScale.description: Scales the whole interface, not only text.

reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: System follows your desktop's accessibility preference.

highContrast.label: High contrast
highContrast.description: Strengthens borders and secondary text to meet WCAG contrast minimums.

titleBar.label: Title bar
titleBar.description: Use Riff's own title bar, or ask your window manager for its decorations.

rememberSidebar.label: Remember sidebar state
rememberSidebar.description: Reopen Riff with the sidebar as you left it.

about.licenseBody: Riff is free software released under the MIT Licence.

links.label: Project links
links.description: Riff makes no network connections. These open in your browser.

exportDiagnostics.label: Export diagnostics
exportDiagnostics.description: Writes one text file with your logs, versions and settings. Your home directory and username are replaced before it is saved, so it is safe to attach to a bug report.

health.label: Installation check
health.description: The same checks `riff doctor` runs. Worth a look if saving has stopped working or a folder will not open.
health.failed: The checks could not be run.
health.repairable: Run `riff repair` in a terminal to fix this.

about.privacy: Riff makes no network connections. Nothing you do here leaves this machine.
